plugins.name: shipshape
plugins.description: Scans a connected computer for cluttered folders or an entire drive, learns how the user already organises their information, and asks before designing anything. Proposes a topic based structure the user can approve in whole or in part, detects cloud-only placeholder files instead of failing on them, keeps clarifying questions to a handful, always shows a review page before touching anything, and can undo or rewind any run since nothing is hard-deleted without a separate later step.

skills.name: declutter
skills.description: Scans a linked computer's messy folders (Downloads, Desktop, Documents, a named folder, or the entire local drive), learns how the user actually organises their information, and proposes a topic based file structure for the user to review and selectively approve before anything is touched. Use when the user says things like "organize my files", "clean up my downloads", "declutter my laptop", "sort my files", "tidy up my desktop/folders", "my files are a mess", or "help me organize my computer".
headings: 2. Scan for scale, not yet for structure
3. Read the existing structure before proposing a new one
4. Report back, then ask before designing
6. Present the plan as a page, get explicit, selective approval
8. Final check, and close the loop on undo

skills.name: undo
skills.description: Reverses a previous Shipshape declutter run, in whole or scoped to just one folder or phase, by replaying its on-disk manifest backwards, and can permanently empty the trash a run left behind. Use when the user says things like "undo the last cleanup", "undo what shipshape did", "put those files back", "rewind [a folder]", "that wasn't right, can you reverse it", or "empty the shipshape trash".
